name: @cyphras/circuits
description: Cyphras private payments ZK circuits (Circom + Groth16 over BN254)

scripts.ptau:prepare: snarkjs powersoftau prepare phase2 build/pot14_0001.ptau build/pot14_final.ptau -v
scripts.setup: snarkjs groth16 setup build/withdraw.r1cs build/pot14_final.ptau build/withdraw_0000.zkey
scripts.zkey:verify: snarkjs zkey verify build/withdraw.r1cs build/pot14_final.ptau build/withdraw_final.zkey
scripts.export-vk: snarkjs zkey export verificationkey build/withdraw_final.zkey build/verification_key.json
scripts.build: npm run compile && npm run ptau:new && npm run ptau:contribute && npm run ptau:prepare && npm run ptau:verify && npm run setup && npm run contribute && npm run zkey:verify && npm run export-vk && npm run parse-vk && npm run vectors
